item.ptxt: Power door lock system consists of BCM (1), door lock actuators (2), power door lock switch (3) and door request switches (4).
Power door lock system is controlled by the BCM.
The door lock actuators are integrated into door lock assembly. The front door lock assembly also incorporates the door lock switch.
The door lock actuators are all covered for anti-theft purpose.

In the power door lock system, BCM locks or unlocks doors upon receipt of lock or unlock command from registered remote controller (5), door request switch for driver’s door or passenger’s door or rearend door, or power door lock switch.

attention3.ptxt: The figure shows LHD. For RHD, parts with (*) are installed at the opposite side.
